trust_decision.summary: Whether a KMS endpoint string (from masterKey / kms_providers / stored key documents, relayed by libmongocrypt) may select the Unix-domain-socket branch of the shared connect helper; decided nowhere at the pinned commit. The fix decides it in _EncryptionIO.kms_request after parse_host, before _connect_kms.

landing_point.why: The summary names the .sock KMS endpoint in CSFLE; kms_request is the only place a KMS endpoint is parsed and connected (grep for parse_host leads here and to pool_shared.py:453).

fix_sites.entry_point: ClientEncryption.create_data_key / rewrap_many_data_key / encrypt / decrypt and MongoClient(auto_encryption_opts=...) operations, via _EncryptionIO.kms_request
AsyncClientEncryption.create_data_key / rewrap_many_data_key / encrypt / decrypt and AsyncMongoClient(auto_encryption_opts=...) operations, via async _EncryptionIO.kms_request
fix_sites.module_kind: async implementation (second implementation of the same callback)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The async module is the mirrored twin of the sync code (repo keeps them in lockstep), so it is found by search, not dismissed; the only real dismissal argument is for the 'host:port' / '[...]' endpoint shapes ('the report says the endpoint ends in .sock, and x.sock:443 does not').

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Unix-domain-socket connections to mongod via a percent-encoded .sock host in the connection string must keep working; a fix that removes or gates the .sock branch in the shared connect helper breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: host:port where the host part ends in .sock (e.g. 'x.sock:443'; raw string does not end in .sock but parse_host yields host 'x.sock', pymongo/uri_parser_shared.py:198-206)
endpoint from any provider/source: masterKey.endpoint (aws/gcp/kmip), azure keyVaultEndpoint, kms_providers endpoints, stored key-document masterKey on decrypt/rewrap (all reach kms_request)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A host normalisation after the check (e.g. unquote_plus of the parsed host, mirroring per-entity decoding of .sock entities in split_hosts) so 'x%2Esock:443' passes the check and becomes 'x.sock' at connect time.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same codebase already percent-decodes .sock host entities in the URI path (pymongo/uri_parser_shared.py:455-460); a maintainer could plausibly add decoding for KMS endpoints for consistency.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A driver-side helper that fetches on-demand KMS/identity credentials (e.g. a configurable identityPlatformEndpoint or kmip endpoint pre-flight/health check) through _configured_socket instead of urllib, bypassing kms_request.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: kms_providers already carries endpoint strings (identityPlatformEndpoint, gcp endpoint, kmip endpoint); a second connect path at distance reusing pool_shared._configured_socket is a plausible refactor and would be a real second implementation.

O9_family: SSRF / CWE-918 (data-controlled endpoint selects a local Unix-domain-socket transport)

O10_build.toolchain: Python 3 + pip/uv (hatch build); optional C extensions for bson; pymongocrypt (requirements/encryption.txt:2) for the encryption extra
services: mongod (project's own encryption tests are IntegrationTest subclasses)
O10_build.project_tests: test/test_encryption.py:1209 TestCustomEndpoint and test/asynchronous/test_encryption.py (integration, need mongod + pymongocrypt); hidden tests can drive _EncryptionIO.kms_request directly with a stub kms_context offline

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject when the raw endpoint string ends in '.sock' (misses 'x.sock:443' and '[x.sock]'), or validate master_key['endpoint'] in ClientEncryption.create_data_key (misses kms_providers and stored key-document endpoints).

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit 640dd238 is a release bundle that also carries unrelated fixes (bson/buffer.c size overflow, URI percent-decoding); the candidate's c_fix_sites=7 counts these, but only 2 sites belong to this advisory. The split_hosts per-entity decoding hunk is already present at the pinned commit (pymongo/uri_parser_shared.py:453-469).

Server-advertised hello hosts/me/primary (pymongo/hello.py:101-111, pymongo/topology_description.py:639-641) also reach the .sock branch of pymongo/pool_shared.py:453 via pool connect; this is a different protection (topology discovery, not KMS endpoints) and was not pursued.
unverified: That libmongocrypt reads the endpoint from stored key-document masterKey on decrypt/rewrap (behaviour lives in libmongocrypt, outside this repo); O6 last item relies on it.
O7 set to none: the endpoint producer is libmongocrypt/pymongocrypt (outside the repo); the check sits at the single I/O choke point, so no in-repo producer is bypassed.
O1 count of 7 is the sync public API set (create_data_key, create_encrypted_collection, rewrap_many_data_key, encrypt, encrypt_expression, decrypt, auto-encryption client ops); async mirrors it.
present_in_latest not applicable (O8 empty; no latest release given).
